lines.claim_ceiling: At most a smoke-scale signal under the old Delta-U endpoint: every C1-E1 branch failed its control gate, so no detector-gain claim may be made and no tuning, seed expansion, or claim promotion is authorized.
lines.hypothesis: Bounded per-proposal native actions over the C1-E1 candidate lattice could improve post-NMS detection utility under the locked Delta-U endpoint.
lines.notes: C3b, D1, D2b, D3, D4, and E1 all froze; only the bounded residual API, identity initialization, and native parity harness are retained.

lines.claim_ceiling: Strong transferable ranking information exists, but the preregistered train-to-validation pairwise gap gate (at most 0.10) failed at 0.1169, so the absolute endpoint remains unvalidated and supports no action or AP claim.
lines.hypothesis: A normalized dense set-quality endpoint Q(S) can be learned from detector-only features and transfer to a detector-unseen validation split within the locked gap gate.
lines.notes: Detector-unseen validation beat all three controls but missed the locked gap gate; cache-only diagnosis found calibration shift rather than broad feature OOD.

lines.claim_ceiling: Weak train-only differential predictability only: pooled within-image pairwise accuracy 0.5747 missed the locked 0.60 gate and a fit-only perturbation-family prior beat the learner, so no endpoint validation, action policy, or AP claim follows.
lines.hypothesis: Continuous identity-invariant local Delta-Q labels Q(S') - Q(S) support a learner that predicts per-candidate set-energy differences beyond a perturbation-family prior.
lines.notes: The learner is frozen rather than enlarged or retuned; reusing the failed 16-image tune split or relaxing the 0.60 gate is post-hoc optimization and is not authorized.

lines.claim_ceiling: None: the one-shot 96/32 split builder failed the locked class-support gate before any cache, training, or GPU work, so the protocol is not executable and no evidence beyond the blocked design exists.
lines.hypothesis: After removing the fit-only family prior mu_f, detector-only set features may predict the content-conditioned residual r = Delta-Q - mu_f on newly locked train-only images.
lines.notes: Tune classes 3 and 8 had one image each against a locked minimum of three; per the no-alternative-manifest rule no second split was generated. Any future residual study must be a new protocol, not a repair of this one.

lines.claim_ceiling: NWPU train-only fit/tune/calibration negative evidence only: post-action re-ROI features passed identity, support, and static-baseline gates but failed matched static-ROI gain, bundle integrity, calibration, and generalization, so this mechanism supports no action, detector-unseen, validation, or AP claim.
lines.hypothesis: Post-action re-ROI evidence supplies transferable residual information about local detector action utility beyond matched static ROI features and a within-image bundle-shuffle control.
lines.notes: Frozen at det.energy.re_roi_counterfactual_evidence.001. Outer heldout and detector validation were not read; no tuning, seed/action/capacity expansion, gate change, or outcome unsealing is authorized for this version.

lines.claim_ceiling: Train-only support-preflight evidence only: 62/250 positive images passed the image floor, but 93 positive candidates missed the locked minimum of 500, so U/W/F/S never ran and no weighting-transfer or AP claim exists.
lines.hypothesis: A train-only no-op-relative oracle utility has enough positive candidate support to test image-level weighted supervised box-head fine-tuning against uniform and assignment-shuffle controls.
lines.notes: Blocked by the preregistered support gate before training. The version config remains preregistered_not_run; the 500-candidate floor, utility source, lambda, weight cap, trainable surface, or arm set may not be relaxed post hoc.

lines.claim_ceiling: Retained only as diagnostic components: prototype-local signals add no per-candidate information beyond the detector score and PAH hurt AP/ECE, so no endpoint or detector-gain claim is supported.
lines.hypothesis: Class prototypes (PrototypeBank, Sinkhorn assignment, ETF/PAH endpoints) define a target manifold that ROI features can be transported toward to improve detection.
lines.notes: Hard-stopped as a known-endpoint claim; PrototypeBank, Sinkhorn, class anchors, and prototype diagnostics are retained for analysis only.

lines.claim_ceiling: Representation diagnostic only: no committed layerwise raw results are auditable and lower ID never converted into action or AP gains, so it cannot support detector-improvement claims.
lines.hypothesis: Lower intrinsic dimension of ROI representations indicates a better correction state for detection.
lines.notes: ID, effective-rank, and NC1 logs are retained as diagnostics; re-promotion to a loss requires information gain beyond detector score/context plus shuffle controls.

lines.claim_ceiling: Batch/group-level structure diagnostic only: per-candidate AUC never beat detector label_prob or shuffle controls, so no scorer, reranker, or primary-loss claim is supported.
lines.hypothesis: Dual intra-class compactness plus inter-class relation energy can serve as a per-candidate scorer or loss that improves detection.
lines.notes: Synthetic checks show the formula is non-degenerate, but real NWPU cache evidence supports only group-level structure diagnostics; cone projection answers local residual stability, not a full manifold endpoint.

lines.claim_ceiling: Invalidated as a causal reward: real and shuffled controls were repeatedly inseparable (on VOC the shuffled control scored slightly higher); retained strictly as an offline ranking feature, diagnostic, and shuffle control.
lines.hypothesis: Handcrafted FFT amplitude, phase, and structure scores can act as a causal external reward for detector training.
lines.notes: Invalidated for the causal reward claim only; raw-iFFT/FFT features remain available as diagnostic signals and no spectral feature expansion is authorized.

lines.claim_ceiling: Historical reproducibility asset: matched-budget box-head and full-model fine-tuning beat RLVR gains, so no current AP claim survives; reusable constraints (signed objective, KL anchor, valid pair masks, rescue budget, false-positive guardrails) are retained for future structured-outcome training.
lines.hypothesis: RLVR, GRPO, or DPO reward and preference training can independently raise detector AP.
lines.notes: Hard-stopped as an independent AP mainline; the stable training shell and its constraints are preserved as reusable assets, not as a current claim.

lines.claim_ceiling: Comparison architecture baseline only: positive evidence on VOC ResNet50 and NWPU MobileNet but unstable across backbones and datasets, so it is not the default mainline and carries no validated claim in this registry.
lines.hypothesis: In-network frequency-domain adaptation (AFM / FPN spectral manifold) improves detector localization.
lines.notes: Old scale-gated AFM evidence is invalidated, but the FPN-SM family is not falsified; restart requires an explicit user request with strong baseline, matched budget, and independent reproduction.
